scope: PM17-02 journal classification and PM17-01 abandoned-launch/root-retarget ownership

findings.result: The shared Overview recovery journal is explicitly classified as absent, verified completed, pending, or unknown. Pending and unknown records fail closed during root retargeting. Foreign-profile, malformed, unreadable, unsupported-schema and unknown-stage records are not treated as harmless. A leftover restored journal is accepted only when its backup manifest independently confirms a schema-1 restored state.
regressions: known unfinished stages: backup_ready, installed_*, restoring_after_failure, closing_failed_owned_game, restoring_after_failed_owned_game_close, active_ready_deferred_restore, closing_owned_game_for_restore, restoring_after_owned_game_exit, restoring_interrupted_operation, restored_*, restoring_while_running, restoring_after_owned_game_close

findings.result: A failed-before-launch attempt keeps its error/attempt identity until a later root selection verifies no active helper, no selected-root game process, and no pending/unknown recovery journal. Persistence occurs before clearing the abandoned identity, so a configuration write failure preserves the old root and state. A supervised helper timeout retains helper ownership until that exact process exits.

same-path partial launch process blocks until process exit
